name: Langfuse Bridge
description: Correlates OpenClaw hooks and diagnostics in Langfuse

publicKey.description: Langfuse public key (pk-lf-...). Falls back to LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.

secretKey.description: Langfuse secret key (sk-lf-...). Falls back to LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.

baseUrl.description: Langfuse host. Falls back to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL, then https://cloud.langfuse.com.

traceLayout.description: Use one generation per model call interleaved with tools, or retain the legacy run-wide generation.

captureConversationContent.description: Capture prompt/response content from conversation hooks. Requires hooks.allowConversationAccess=true.

captureToolContent.description: Capture tool params/results from before_tool_call and after_tool_call.

piiFiltering.description: Redact high-confidence PII from captured content locally before export: email addresses, Taiwan mobile numbers, Luhn-valid payment card numbers, Taiwan national IDs, and values under explicit PII field names.

maxContentBytes.description: Maximum sanitized bytes sent for any captured input or output field.
